method: Custom single-scatter plus simplified Monte Carlo transport in water (500k primary photons, with Klein–Nishina Compton, photo, pair, Rayleigh and CSDA electron transport with Molière scattering). Photon fluence scored by track-length in the 1-cm-radius, 0.2-cm cylinder at 10 cm depth; electrons set in motion scored from in-cylinder photon interactions (Layer 3) and tracked from sources within 2.5 cm of the cylinder (Layers 4–5). Dose from collision-stopping-power×track-length; kerma from energy transfer and from mu_en-weighted photon fluence; delta-ray fluence estimated from Moller cross-section fraction (~6%). Depth dose computed from primary attenuation (mu=0.0493 cm^-1 at 2 MeV) plus scatter contribution, with dmax≈0.8-1 cm. Interaction fractions and spectra combine direct MC statistics with deterministic fluence-weighted cross-section integrals.
data_sources: Photon cross sections: Klein–Nishina with incoherent-scattering-function correction, process partition calibrated to NIST XCOM for water (mu/rho_total(2 MeV)=0.0493 cm^2/g; mu_en/rho=0.0233 cm^2/g); pair, photo and Rayleigh from XCOM-type energy tables. Electron stopping powers and CSDA ranges from ICRU Report 49 values for water (Bethe formula). Radiation length 36.1 g/cm^2. Air stopping-power data from ICRU 37/49 for the Spencer–Attix ratio.
